about: Who speaks in each lesson video (comms/course.py loads the transcripts as `video:<lesson id>`). `single`: one coach presents, so every quote is the presenter's. `multi`: a live session; a quote needs `speaker` (a coach's name, checked by reading the passage) and students' words never count. `student`: a student's own deal story; quotes need `speaker: "student"` and back only `tip` rules (an example of what worked, not a coach's rule). Eyoub El Habib (Abu Lahya, 'Ayyub') is the head coach who presents most general lessons: he names himself in 1.2 Learn how to Communicate and students in the calls say 'Abu Lahya, Ayyub'. Corrected from the transcripts as each video is read. A `speaker` of 'A|B' means certainly one of these coaches, unclear which.
